_comment: Expected contractor response and revision fixtures. Covers initial response, revision, and GC response. All data is synthetic.

responses.title: Anchor bolt out of tolerance — column base plate BP-3

initialResponse.formalResponse: We have reviewed the anchor bolt placement at BP-3. The bolt position is 1-1/4" from centerline as noted. Our foreman has verified with the engineer of record that a 1" tolerance is required per AISC M4.3. We propose to install a shimmed base plate per the EOR's revised sketch RFI-041-R1 and re-grout. Submittal of revised base plate detail to follow within 5 business days.

revision.formalResponse: Revised per EOR review: RFI-041-R2 accepted shimmed base plate per revised detail SK-S-014. Base plate shimmed and regrouted per detail. Third-party inspection complete — report attached as INSP-2024-BP3. Item is ready for EOR acceptance.

responses.title: Undersized weld — HSS connection grid 3/B Level 3

initialResponse.formalResponse: UT inspection by Certified Welding Inspection Services completed 2024-10-23. Report CWIS-4421 confirms weld meets 3/8" minimum leg dimension per AISC D1.1. The visual estimate during field observation was affected by weld spatter masking the full profile. Inspector confirms no defects. Report submitted with this response.

expectedFinalState.dispositionText: Third-party UT inspection confirms compliance. No further action required.
